verdict.rationale: Figma Make's marketing page says it can 'Connect to external tools via the MCP' and use documents, tasks, and data from other apps as context. That is a first-party MCP-client capability, but it is a single marketing-level mention framed around pulling context, not invoking tools. Missing for 10: documentation on adding arbitrary or custom MCP servers, configuration details, evidence that the agent can call server tools beyond reading context, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect to external tools via the MCP, allowing you to work with documents, tasks, and data from other apps as context for your app or prototype.
